title: Verified component-wise RUP certificate generation
claims: ComponentwiseRUPSearch lifts a measured local generator to canonical co-occurrence components, verifying all emitted certificates against the original formula.
HybridComponentRUPSearch is complete on formulas whose variable components are independently width-two or renamable Horn and returns bounded valid global refutations.
ExactRUPRefutationVerifier and the measured width-two and renamable Horn certificate generators are retained to replay the component construction.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
